From: Anna Li <anna@spectra-analytics.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Interleaved demo bridge — coordinating across timezones

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the quick response on the intro call last week. Our product and platform teams are split across EMEA (UK/GER) and APAC (SG/AU) and we want to invite both groups to a single demo day without running two full events.

High-level asks:
- Can we run a single "interleaved" demo where we alternate short live segments for each region with a shared Q&A?
- We need two host options (one primetime EMEA, one primetime APAC) and an easy way to surface recordings for the off-shift audience.
- Expect ~18 technical attendees + 6 product managers.

Availability windows: EMEA prefers 10:00–13:00 BST, APAC prefers 15:00–19:00 SGT (which overlaps awkwardly).

Are you able to propose a rhythm that keeps sessions ~30 minutes per region but maintains a coherent flow? We can loop in Tom Reynolds (technical lead) if you want a second calendar to coordinate.

Thanks,
Anna Li
Senior PM, Spectra Analytics
anna@spectra-analytics.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <anna@spectra-analytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Interleaved demo bridge — coordinating across timezones

Hi Anna — great prompt.

We can absolutely run an "interleaved" bridge. Proposed delta plan below (short form):

Plan: Staggered 90-minute demo block with interleaved 30/30 segments + 30 shared Q&A
- 00:00–00:30: EMEA-focused walkthrough (features + latency/cost summary)
- 00:30–01:00: APAC-focused walkthrough (deployment/Private options + billing model)
- 01:00–01:30: Joint Q&A + next steps / mutual action plan

Logistics:
- One Zoom bridge with breakout-disabled; use host spotlight for presenter handoffs.
- Record entire session and produce two trimmed videos (EMEA package, APAC package).
- We’ll run host rotation: I host EMEA segment, Ben hosts APAC. Lauren will manage poll and live PRFAQ capture.

I attached a draft agenda (spectra_demo_agenda_v1.docx) and an ICS that follows the 90-minute block. Ben, Lauren — ok if you take host/runbook tasks below?

Action items for Spectra: confirm preferred start time (we can make the block start at 10:00 BST / 17:00 SGT to slot into both windows) and confirm attendee list.

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: spectra_demo_agenda_v1.docx, interleaved_calendar.ics

+1 to Hannah’s plan. A couple of operational notes from infra side: 
- Keep each live walkthrough to ~25 minutes max to allow 5 minutes buffer for handoff and unexpected latency spikes.
- We should enable prefix caching demo early in the EMEA segment since it’s a quick wins demo for cost/latency.
- I'll prepare a short quantized-vs-fp demo snippet to show 2–3ms differences on a typical 2k token prompt (this will fit the 10–12 min APAC slot).

If Spectra confirms the 10:00 BST / 17:00 SGT start, I’ll create a host runbook and test bridge at least 48 hours prior.

Hannah — this looks promising. Tom and I reviewed the agenda and we like the 90-minute interleaved format. Quick clarifying points:
- Can the recording be split and delivered within 24 hours? We have to distribute to a leadership audience in APAC next day.
- We’d prefer the joint Q&A at the end rather than interspersed; is that doable without losing momentum?

Start time: 10:00 BST works for EMEA; Tom confirms APAC can join 17:00 SGT. Please go ahead and send the calendar invite. Also, can you add a short attendee poll to check whether people intend to watch live vs watch recording?

Best,
Anna
